floor.description: 1.5% of every buy and sell puffs the floor pool; it rises with volume and never deflates
floor.backing: floor pool always holds enough to buy back the entire circulating supply at floor price
floor.custody: immutable FOBO hook - no LP tokens, no withdraw function, no admin key

supply.release: slow FOBO curve - approx 35% sold by $1B market cap

dataSources.note: block height and gas price are read client-side from public RPCs - no server in between

risk: Memecoin with no intrinsic value. Floor mechanics reduce liquidity risk, not market risk. Can go to zero. Not financial advice.
